name: player_capture_current_object_pose_as_restart_anchor
description: Player::CaptureCurrentObjectPoseAsRestartAnchor captures the local root-node position and yaw into a target save-state restart anchor.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to the coherent Player source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42be70 validates loading g_LocalPlayerSaveState->playerState, reading root-node position with zClass_Object3D::gwObject3DGetPosition, reading root-node rotation with zClass_Object3D::gwObject3DGetRotation, and forwarding the captured position plus yaw to Player::SetWorldPoseAndRestartAnchor.

The native smoke configures a local Object3D root node, calls CaptureCurrentObjectPoseAsRestartAnchor for a target save state, and verifies the target world position, previous-transform translation, restart yaw, and variant-tag clear performed through SetWorldPoseAndRestartAnchor.
